title: Transitivity of polynomial-time reducibility
statement: Let $L,L',L''$ be languages over the binary alphabet. If $L\le_p L'$ and $L'\le_p L''$, then $L\le_p L''$, where $\le_p$ denotes polynomial-time Karp reducibility.
hypotheses_covered: $L,L',L''$ are languages over the binary alphabet
replaced:
Let $L, L', L'' \subseteq \{0,1\}^{*}$ be languages. If $L \le_p L'$ and
$L' \le_p L''$, where $\le_p$ denotes polynomial-time Karp reducibility, then
$L \le_p L''$ [AB09, Theorem~2.8.1].
